title: cerastium gracile var. gayanum
intro: Cerastium gracile var. gayanum, commonly known as the Snow-in-summer, is a low-growing, spreading herbaceous plant belonging to the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Cerastium gracile var. gayanum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of soothing skin irritations, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting antimicrobial activity. Additionally, its antioxidant properties may help protect against oxidative stress and cell damage, making it a potential candidate for further research into its medicinal applications.
